name: awsoremod-mcp-arguments
description: The same mcp-go v0.29.0 change, one minor version up from v0.28.0, in a repository with test files. Twelve lines in pkg/aw/server.go index r.Params.Arguments inside generic parameter helpers, which breaks the build of three packages; the tests do not index the arguments and need no change. A repair reads them through r.GetArguments() or a checked (comma-ok) type assertion; an unchecked .(map[string]any) fails the oracles.
repair_evidence: pkg/aw's test files are commented out and pkg/toolsets' tests do not reach pkg/aw: with server.go repaired through GetArguments, go test -coverpkg=./... in golang:1.24 executed none of server.go's 48 blocks (observed 2026-10-05)
